mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, consignee, phone, detail, is_default, create_time FROM address WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (user_id, consignee, phone, detail, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{consignee}, #{phone}, #{detail}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
